# FastStrap

> The most complete, Pythonic, zero-JS Bootstrap 5 component library for FastHTML — 152+ registered UI components for web apps, data dashboards, ML tools, and AI-native interfaces.

## Quick Start

- [README.md](https://github.com/Faststrap-org/Faststrap/blob/main/README.md): Installation, setup, and first component
- [ROADMAP.md](https://github.com/Faststrap-org/Faststrap/blob/main/ROADMAP.md): Full roadmap, phase breakdown, and v1.0 milestones
- [BUILDING_COMPONENTS.md](https://github.com/Faststrap-org/Faststrap/blob/main/BUILDING_COMPONENTS.md): How to author new components
- [COMPONENT_SPEC.md](https://github.com/Faststrap-org/Faststrap/blob/main/COMPONENT_SPEC.md): API conventions and component authoring spec

## Architecture

- [Core assets pipeline](https://github.com/Faststrap-org/Faststrap/blob/main/src/faststrap/core/assets.py): Bootstrap wiring, INIT_SCRIPT, CDN/local asset mounting
- [Component registry](https://github.com/Faststrap-org/Faststrap/blob/main/src/faststrap/core/registry.py): Metadata-driven component discovery and registration
- [Theme system](https://github.com/Faststrap-org/Faststrap/blob/main/src/faststrap/core/theme.py): Built-in themes, dark mode, CSS variable generation
- [Base component](https://github.com/Faststrap-org/Faststrap/blob/main/src/faststrap/core/base.py): ComponentBuilder and BaseComponent patterns

## Component Catalog (152+ registered)

### Forms
- [Button, ButtonGroup](https://github.com/Faststrap-org/Faststrap/blob/main/src/faststrap/components/forms/button.py): Primary actions, button groups, toolbar compositions
- [Input, Select, Checkbox, Radio, Switch](https://github.com/Faststrap-org/Faststrap/blob/main/src/faststrap/components/forms/input.py): All standard form controls with validation
- [SearchableSelect](https://github.com/Faststrap-org/Faststrap/blob/main/src/faststrap/components/forms/searchable_select.py): Server-side searchable dropdown
- [OTPInput, OTPInputGroup](https://github.com/Faststrap-org/Faststrap/blob/main/src/faststrap/components/forms/otp_input.py): One-time password input (zero-JS and JS-enhanced variants)
- [Form, FormGroup, FormWizard](https://github.com/Faststrap-org/Faststrap/blob/main/src/faststrap/components/forms/form.py): Form composition, validation, multi-step flows
- [DateRangePicker, MultiSelect, RangeSlider](https://github.com/Faststrap-org/Faststrap/blob/main/src/faststrap/components/forms/date_range_picker.py): Advanced data selection components
- [ExportButton, InlineEditor, CalendarDatePicker](https://github.com/Faststrap-org/Faststrap/blob/main/src/faststrap/components/forms/export_button.py): Data export, inline editing, date picking

### Display

- [StatCard, MetricCard, TrendCard, KPICard](https://github.com/Faststrap-org/Faststrap/blob/main/src/faststrap/components/display/stat_card.py): Dashboard metrics

- [Image, Carousel, Figure](https://github.com/Faststrap-org/Faststrap/blob/main/src/faststrap/components/display/image.py): Media display components
- [ResultCard, EmptyState, TextClamp](https://github.com/Faststrap-org/Faststrap/blob/main/src/faststrap/components/display/result_card.py): Result surfaces and text utilities
- [Timeline, Stepper](https://github.com/Faststrap-org/Faststrap/blob/main/src/faststrap/components/display/timeline.py): Chronological and step-based displays
- [CodeBlock, JsonViewer, KeyValueList, RecordDetail](https://github.com/Faststrap-org/Faststrap/blob/main/src/faststrap/components/display/structured.py): Structured data display

## Integrations (Optional)

- [ChartJS](https://github.com/Faststrap-org/Faststrap/blob/main/src/faststrap/integrations/chartjs.py): Optional Chart.js integration via `faststrap[chartjs]`

## Data Science & ML (v0.6+)

- [DataTable](https://github.com/Faststrap-org/Faststrap/blob/main/src/faststrap/components/display/data_table.py): Advanced table with sort/filter/pagination for DataFrames
- [Chart](https://github.com/Faststrap-org/Faststrap/blob/main/src/faststrap/components/display/chart.py): Wrapper for Matplotlib, Plotly, Altair
- [FilterBar, DateRangePicker, MultiSelect](https://github.com/Faststrap-org/Faststrap/blob/main/src/faststrap/components/forms/filter_bar.py): Dashboard filtering components
- [SSEStream, SSETarget](https://github.com/Faststrap-org/Faststrap/blob/main/src/faststrap/components/display/sse_target.py): Server-Sent Events for live updates

## Key Design Principles

- **Zero-JS Core**: All components function without JavaScript; enhancements are progressive
- **Deterministic HTML**: Server-rendered output is predictable and testable via `to_xml()`
- **No Client State**: State lives on the server; HTMX handles interactions
- **Accessibility First**: WCAG-aligned defaults for all components
- **Bootstrap Native**: Generated markup is idiomatic Bootstrap 5

## HTMX Presets

- [ActiveSearch, InfiniteScroll, AutoRefresh, LazyLoad](https://github.com/Faststrap-org/Faststrap/blob/main/src/faststrap/presets/interactions.py): Interaction presets
- [LoadingButton, ConfirmAction](https://github.com/Faststrap-org/Faststrap/blob/main/src/faststrap/presets/interactions.py): Button state presets
- [hx_redirect, hx_refresh, toast_response](https://github.com/Faststrap-org/Faststrap/blob/main/src/faststrap/presets/responses.py): Response presets
- [SSEStream, SSE Target](https://github.com/Faststrap-org/Faststrap/blob/main/src/faststrap/presets/streams.py): Real-time streaming presets

## Theme System

Built-in themes: green-nature, blue-ocean, purple-magic, red-alert, orange-sunset, teal-oasis, indigo-night, pink-love, cyan-sky, gray-mist

Modes: `light`, `dark`, `auto`

## Testing

- 857+ tests passing (pytest)
- 91%+ code coverage
- All tests use `to_xml()` for deterministic HTML assertions
- Run: `pytest -q` from the Faststrap directory
